cdda.core.faction.balthazar_fac.descript.other: A mysterious figure who operates out of a bunker.  They're trying to restore some semblance of infrastructure.

cdda.core.furniture.f_balthazar_server.d.other: The servers Balthazar is running on.  Destroying these will severely damage, if not kill them.

cdda.core.furniture.f_metal_detector.des.other: A metal detector like one you'd see at the airport.  This one is no longer functioning.

cdda.core.item.analytical_set_basic.desc.other: A hefty kit containing some basic things you should probably not try to do precise chemistry without: a small balance scale, a spectrophotometer, cuvettes, a melting point apparatus, a pH meter, and a set of paper for thin layer chromatography.  This makes it a lot easier to feel confident that the chemical you've made is what you think it is.

cdda.core.item.balthazar_radio.descripti.other: A modified portable radio.  A mess of metal and wires has been attached to the back and the frequency dial has been removed.

cdda.core.item.balthazar_radio.use_actio.other:
You turn the radio on.

Just static.

You turn on the radio.  You hear a broadcast:
"If anyone can hear, I'm stuck in a bunker and need help.  I'm also transmitting my coordinates.  This message will repeat."
You note down the coordinates.

You turn on the radio.  You hear a broadcast:
"If anyone who is listening to this broadcast is willing to do work for weapons, head to the transmitted coordinates.  This message will repeat."
You write down the coordinates.

cdda.core.item.duffelbag.description.other: A canvas duffel bag.  Provides plenty of storage, but is fairly encumbering.

cdda.core.item.lws32.description.other: A very small pistol chambered in .32 ACP.  Due to its intended role, it lacks any sights.

cdda.core.item.lws32.variant.lws32.descr.other: A very small pistol chambered in .32 ACP.  It lacks any sort of sights as it's designed for very close engagement distances.

cdda.core.item.lws32mag.description.other: A 6 round magazine for the micro conceal carry pistol.

cdda.core.item.lws32mag.variant.lws32mag.other: A 6 round magazine for the LWS 32.

cdda.core.item.remington_700_308.descrip.other: A very accurate rifle chambered for the powerful .308 round.

cdda.core.item.remington_700_308.variant.other: An ubiquitous bolt action rifle, the Model 700 is used by police agencies, militaries, and civilians alike around the globe.  Simple, accurate, and cheap.

cdda.core.item.savage_rascal.description.other: A .22 Long Rifle rifle that chambers just one shot.  Its main use is for the youth, and not much else.  God help you if you hope to use this thing to a meaningful effect.

cdda.core.mission_definition.mission_get.other: Power is holding for now but I need those panels soon.
The power in my bunker is failing and I need 12 solar panels to stabilize them.
Most commercial buildings have some solar panels or, if we're lucky, you might find a solar farm.
Balthazar needs some solar panels to stabilize the power to their bunker.

cdda.core.mod_migration.speedydex.remova.other: Does not meet repo requirements of offering a different, curated gameplay experience.  Mod can trivially be reproduced in JSON with enchantments.

cdda.core.mod_migration.stats_through_ki.other: Does not meet repo requirements of offering a different, curated gameplay experience.

cdda.core.mod_migration.stats_through_sk.other: Hardcode that enabled this was removed and it doesn't meet repo inclusion criteria, non-hardcoded alternatives are available out of repo.

cdda.core.monster.mon_nether_cucumber.de.other: Pink and translucent, with all of its otherworldly organs visible through its skin, this meter-high conical creature creeps along the seabed with its stubby, furry legs.  It retracts some sort of barbed filaments into an orifice at its rear as it aims at potential prey.

cdda.core.monster.mon_zombie_soldier_lix.other: Once a soldier, it is dressed head to toe in combat gear and carries itself rather steadily for a zombie.  Over its uniform is a vest reading "military police".

cdda.core.practice.prac_armorsmithing.pr.other: Practice working metal into the form of various armor pieces, and test their articulation with you using some cotton for padding along with the armor pieces.

cdda.core.practice.prac_blacksmithing.pr.other: Practice working metal into some simple but useful forms and designs.

cdda.core.practice.prac_bladesmith.pract.other: Practice working metal into the form of useful blades of all sizes and designs, grind them until you learn how much is too much.

cdda.core.practice.prac_case_hardening.p.other: Practice heating steel packed in charcoal at different high temperatures and times, and then comparing the properties of the resulting hard case.

cdda.core.practice.prac_quenching.practi.other: Practice heating chunks of steel and quickly cooling them down with water, and then, to reduce brittleness and restore ductility, heating them again to maximize its properties.

cdda.core.practice.prac_redsmithing.prac.other: Practice the basics of redsmithing by working copper into some simple forms and designs.

cdda.core.practice.prac_redsmithing_adv..other: Practice the more advanced techniques of redsmithing by working bronze into different and complex forms and designs.

cdda.core.practice.prac_toolsmithing.pra.other: Practice working metal into the complex forms and designs of several tools like hammers and screwdrivers.

cdda.core.proficiency.prof_redsmithing.p.other: A basic understanding of the techniques required to work with copper and bronze, soft metals require a somewhat different kind of skill set than blacksmithing.

cdda.core.proficiency.prof_redsmithing_a.other: You can now easily work with the more ductile copper-containing metals and could probably make a living in the Bronze Age.

cdda.core.scenario.overrun.description.f.other: Despite all the soldiers, guns, and barbed wire, the military base you were in was overrun by the dead.  Everyone was ordered to fall back to the armory, but during all the chaos you got lost and you are now stuck in the warehouse by yourself.  You are not sure if anyone made it to the armory, or if you are the last one alive.

cdda.core.scenario.overrun.description.m.other: Despite all the soldiers, guns, and barbed wire, the military base you were in was overrun by the dead.  Everyone was ordered to fall back to the armory, but during all the chaos you got lost and you are now stuck in the warehouse by yourself.  You are not sure if anyone made it to the armory, or if you are the last one alive.

cdda.core.talk_topic.mission_robofac_int.other: I don't believe I'm cleared to-"  You hear brief chatter.  "Apologies; I was mistaken.  The manufacturer was, technically speaking, kept secret from the public.  As a result, it operated using an office tower as a front, and was located underground.  An elevator in the back of the building led to the basement, but it was likely destroyed in the damage and the shaft may well be inaccessible - as a result, you will need to find a way down yourself.  There is a maintenance staircase in the compound, which may provide a means of entry should you be able to find an access card on the premises.

cdda.core.talk_topic.talk_balthazar_inte.other: As soon as you walk up to the intercom it turns on
Once you get close enough, the intercom crackles on
The wiring on this intercom is out for anyone to see
You hear some static come through the tinny speaker
After some brief static you hear a voice coming through with a crackle and a pop "..llo?  Hello?  Is someone there?"
Why don't these robots attack me?

cdda.core.talk_topic.talk_balthazar_meet.other: You'll help me?!  Thank you so, so much.  I really wasn't looking forward to dying a slow death in here.  I think the power will be enough for a while but please hurry up.
What should I do once I bring them to you?
I'm a combat engineer who got sent here to hold this bunker.  I guess I'm still accomplishing that, huh.
How come you're locked up?
Just gotta keep my head down and focus on the now.
Good luck.

When the riots were getting bad, we were assigned to hold this bunker for some eggheads.  Then when the skies broke some of my comrades just started shooting all around, so I fled into this bunker.  Something messed with the doors and I've been locked in here since.
That sounds rough.
I can remotely control a few of the maintenance bots.  All I need you to do is drop them off at the intercom I've managed to set up and I'll get to work installing them.

The bunker has a field of solar panels nearby but some of the staff damaged them badly when they turned into those… things.  I need you to gather at least 12 panels so I can stabilize my power output.
Alright, I'll see what I can gather.
The airlock is the only part that is malfunctioning, luckily it's connected to the ventilation systems so I made a bot that can traverse them.
W-Wait no, n- no, I- I'll give you all I have.  All I request to keep is some food, a gun, and a bullet for if things get bad.
That's better.
How about a little more, huh?
I-I-What?  It's all I have, I can't give you more.
So you also don't have anything else in the "control center"?
Surely you have something more exotic in there.
Y- You know what?  Fuck you, I'll just wait for someone else.
Wh- Alright, you got me, I can offer you a bot from the control center as well, but that is truly all I have.
Surely you have some more in there.
I knew you had more.
I don't have much.  All I have in here is some MREs, bullets and a few guns so I'll let you take your pick when you bring some panels.
You're locked in there, right?  How would I get them?
That doesn't sound too promising…
This bunker has a control center for the local bots so I made them only attack when attacked first.
So you do have some tech you can give me.
Sounds useful.
I have no need for you right now.

I'm Balthazar and have been stuck in this bunker ever since the sky ruptured!  I don't really know what's happening out there and need someone to help me.  The power to the bunker has been running low and the air & water filtration are failing intermittently.
So who are you?
What do you need help with?
What's in it for me?
Hold on, why are you locked in here?

cdda.core.talk_topic.talk_balthazar_no_t.other: I'll first need to gather up some supplies before I can even consider trading.

cdda.core.talk_topic.talk_balthazar_robo.other: I got a control center.  Anything else or will you hear me out now?

cdda.core.talk_topic.talk_balthazar_self.other: I'm a combat engineer who got sent here to hold this bunker.  Can we get down to business now?
Something forced me to hide in here.  Will you help me now?
Fine, what do you need help with?
I wanted to know something else first…
Not until I know who you are.

cdda.core.talk_topic.talk_balthazar_sola.other: On second thought, I need a bit longer.
Thank you so much.  As promised, all I can spare and a bot.
Thank you so much, I'll give you all I have to give right now.
Thank you so much, I'll send some bullets and a gun over.

cdda.mod.mind_over_matter.help.awakening.other: Unlike learning spells, psionics are not guaranteed.  Each newly-created character has only a chance to gain powers.  This chance is variable per character, set when your character is created, and can range from 50% to as little as 1%.  Furthermore, every path you learn decreases your odds to learn future paths, though it never becomes impossible.  You may take the Latent Psion trait at character creation to ensure that your first attempt to awaken psionic powers is always successful, but this does affect the diminishing returns of attempting to awaken additional paths.  You do not need to take this trait if you start the game with any type of psionic powers; starting psions are assumed to have been latent.
You can also choose psychic knacks; see its own help topic for a full explanation.

cdda.mod.mind_over_matter.help.basics.po.other: Psionics are different in several ways than the magical powers in Magiclysm.  For one, all psionics require stamina to use rather than an external resource such as mana, meaning a full-charged psion is only a short breather away.  Second, psionic powers scale with your intelligence stat and with your Nether Attunement (q.v.) as well as with the power level; this includes their maximum possible level, which is equal to your intelligence times 1.5.  Third, long-duration powers must be concentrated on to be maintained, and negative effects like being injured, being electrocuted, or inhaling toxic smoke can cause you to lose your concentration.  Lose your concentration when you're levitating or maintaining a pyrokinetic shield against fire and you're in for a world of hurt and possibly the character creation screen.

cdda.mod.mind_over_matter.help.paths.bio.other: 1) Biokinesis: Control over physical bodily processes such as respiration, metabolism, skin elasticity, or pain response.  Master biokinetics can be stronger or faster than any human can hope to be, cross short distances in the blink of an eye, turn bolts or pull up nails using only their hands, hold their breath for tens of minutes, and surpass the human pinnacle in every realm of unarmed combat.

cdda.mod.mind_over_matter.help.paths.cla.other: 2) Clairsentience: Enhanced perception and use of senses beyond the physical and short-term precognition, such as hearing high or low frequencies or seeing through walls or to distant places.  Master clairsentients can predict opponents' movements in combat, account for all possible effects on their ranged weapons to make the perfect shot, have visions of nearby places, and sense danger and those who try to harm them.

cdda.mod.mind_over_matter.help.paths.ele.other: 3) Electrokinesis: Control over electricity and some electrochemical processes, including the function of neurons and computers.  Master electrokinetics can shock opponents by touch, recharge electronics on their person, stun or shut down robots, paralyze beings with a nervous system, speed up their own neural processes or those of others, and unleash blasts of lightning.

cdda.mod.mind_over_matter.help.paths.int.other: There are nine paths of psionics in Mind over Matter, as follows:

cdda.mod.mind_over_matter.help.paths.pho.other: 4) Photokinesis: Control over light, radiation, and radio waves.  Master photokinetics can cause the nearby air to glow, create illusions around themselves to hide their position or even disappear, change their appearance, unleash laser blasts, listen to radio broadcasts, and glow as brightly as the noonday sun.

cdda.mod.mind_over_matter.help.paths.pyr.other: 5) Pyrokinesis: Control over heat and fire.  Master pyrokinetics can wear a light t-shirt in a blizzard, light wood with just a thought, unleash blasts of flame on their enemies, surround themselves with a curtain of flame, and heat up a location hot enough to metal steel.

cdda.mod.mind_over_matter.help.paths.tel.other: 6) Telekinesis: Moving objects without touching them.  Master telekinetics can throw objects or people through the air, walk on water, create a barrier that inhibits fast-moving attacks, carry an object next to them without touching it, fly, or even cause small earthquakes.

7) Telepathy: Perception and manipulation of others' thoughts.  Master telepaths can read minds, influence others' moods to calm them down, tame even normally-untameable animals, stun and damage enemies with mental feedback, erase their perceptions from their targets' minds, and even take control of their enemies and make them fight for the psion.

8) Teleportation: Movement without crossing the intervening distance.  Master teleporters can increase the relative distances around their enemies to slow their movements, reduce the relative distances around themselves to make melee attacks from several meters away, teleport through walls or from the first floor to the roof, walk through walls, travel long distances to places they have previously been, and open temporary rifts into the Nether.

cdda.mod.mind_over_matter.help.paths.tit.other: Mind Over Matter: Types of Psionics

cdda.mod.mind_over_matter.help.paths.vit.other: 9) Vitakinesis: Control of health and vitality, such as bloodflow, susceptibility to disease, healing speed, and need for sleep.  Master vitakinesis can slow or staunch bloodflow, increase the recovery rate of either a particular location or of their whole body, meditate instead of sleep, purge themselves of toxins or diseases, disrupt the bodily functions of their enemies, and heal grievous wounds in minutes.

cdda.mod.mind_over_matter.help.psychic_k.other: Not every path has knacks available, and not every power can be taken as a knack.  Knacks can only be taken during character creation.  If you take a knack, you cannot start as a Latent Psion.

Psychic knacks are meant to represent the kind of psychics that often show up in horror literature, who are born with a certain set of powers and might get better at them but rarely laterally branch out.  They are meant to represent characters with one or a small number of tricks they can use to their advantage.  In exchange, psychic knacks are one-half the Difficulty that the full psionic power is, making them both easier to use and less subject to Nether Attunement.

Psychic knacks are another way of starting the game with psionic powers, but in a different way than awakenings.  Awakenings are artificial, induced by matrix crystals or portal storms, but knacks are innate.  Someone with a knack was born with their powers, though they probably didn't fully gain them until later in life.

Each knack is self contained.  A knack for Chameleoflage allows the psychic to blend into their surroundings, and a knack for Mind Sense allows the psychic to locate nearby minds, and *that's it*.  They are not a full photokinetic or telepath and they will not gain any new powers.  What's more, something about knacks seems to interfere with matrix and portal awakenings.  The more knacks a character has, the harder awakening as a psion will be.  However, if you do awaken, any appropriate knacks are converted over into powers in your path (if applicable) and you become eligible for learning new powers.

cdda.mod.mind_over_matter.help.using_pow.other: Powers have a chance to fail based on a number of factors.  The most important by far is your Metaphysics skill vs. the power's Difficulty, and the chance of failure is also reduced by our intelligence and, to a much lesser extent, the power's level.  It is increased by having a high Nether Attunement, by channeling several powers in short succession, and by having lower weariness levels (Moderate or below). Your chance of success is capped based on whether you have the concentration proficiencies or not; only with Concentration (Master) can you reach 100% chance to succeed.
Psionic powers are located in your supernatural powers menu, categorized by path.  Each psionic power is preceded by a [Ψ].

Psionic powers require stamina to fuel them, as well as calories.  The amount of stamina is listed in the supernatural powers screen.  The calorie cost is not, but scales with the Difficulty of the power.  This calorie cost is treated the same as calories burned through exertion in all respects; they can be tracked with an exercise band and their expenditure will make you more weary.  Increasing the level of a particular power will reduce the stamina cost but it will not reduce the calorie cost.
